slots.body: Invite the people you publish with

examples.label: Account setup steps as separated cards
examples.source:
Finish setting up your account

<.component component_name="chelekom-list" site="Global" id="list-account-setup" variant="base_separated" size="small" space="extra_small" rounded="medium"> <:item padding="small">Confirm your email address from the link we just sent. <:item padding="small">Add a company name and logo so invoices look right. <:item padding="small">Invite the teammates who will publish with you. <:item padding="small">Connect a domain and publish your first page.

examples.label: How to return an order
examples.source:
How to return an order

<.component component_name="chelekom-list" site="Global" id="list-return-order" size="small"> <:item padding="extra_small">Open the order in your account and choose Start a return. <:item padding="extra_small">Print the prepaid label we email you within one business day. <:item padding="extra_small">Drop the parcel at any carrier point within 14 days. <:item padding="extra_small">We refund the original payment method once the parcel reaches our warehouse.

examples.label: Numbered clauses in a terms of service section
examples.source:
Payment and renewal

<.component component_name="chelekom-list" site="Global" id="list-terms-clauses" size="small"> <:item padding="extra_small">Subscriptions renew automatically on the anniversary of the purchase date. <:item padding="extra_small">We email an invoice to the billing address on file seven days before each renewal. <:item padding="extra_small">You may cancel at any time; access continues until the end of the paid period. <:item padding="extra_small">Prices announced on this page apply from the next renewal, never retroactively.
